is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. gambiae s.s. and An. arabiensis) in Bobo-Dioulasso, Burkina Faso.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (kdr-west) and Ace-1 G280S (ace-1R) in Tables 4 and 5.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Tables 4 and 5 provide genotype counts (SS, RS, RR) for kdr and ace-1R mutations by species and location.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from field sites in Bobo-Dioulasso, Burkina Faso (Dioulassoba and Kodeni).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical field study conducted in 2008.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies two districts in Bobo-Dioulasso: Dioulassoba and Kodeni.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was carried out from May to December 2008.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a specific entomological survey conducted in 2008.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts and bioassay data are provided in the main text tables (Tables 2, 3, 4, and 5).

assessment.summary: This study investigated the population dynamics, Plasmodium infection rates, and insecticide resistance of Anopheles gambiae s.l. in two districts of Bobo-Dioulasso, Burkina Faso, in 2008. It reports the prevalence of An. arabiensis and An. gambiae s.s., and provides genotype frequencies for the L1014F kdr and G119S ace-1R mutations.
